features.name: x1_x2_product_01
features.description: Bounded product of X1 and X2, capturing their joint level on a 0 to 1 scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a direct multiplicative axis so a linear SVM can represent joint X1-X2 effects.

features.name: x1_x2_midrange_hump_01
features.description: Smooth hump over the X1-X2 product, highest when the product is near the middle of its range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a mid-product bump, enabling a linear margin to model rise-and-fall behavior from the X1-X2 pair.

features.name: x1_x2_sqrt_product_01
features.description: Concave transform of the X1-X2 product, emphasizing differences among smaller joint levels.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the SVM another smooth basis direction for approximating curved X1-X2 behavior.

features.name: x3_center_abs_01
features.description: Normalized absolute distance of X3 from the midpoint 0.5.
features.expected_model_benefit: Measures severity of X3 being away from the midpoint with a linear-scale margin input.

features.name: x3_center_quadratic_01
features.description: Normalized squared distance of X3 from the midpoint 0.5.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes symmetric quadratic curvature in X3 as a margin-ready input.

features.name: x4_level_01
features.description: Bounded X4 level on the native 0 to 1 scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Preserves the strong first-order X4 direction on a bounded scale.

features.name: x5_level_01
features.description: Bounded X5 level on the native 0 to 1 scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Preserves the first-order X5 direction on a bounded scale.

features.name: x4_x5_weighted_level_01
features.description: Weighted linear projection of X4 and X5 using a 2-to-1 emphasis on X4, scaled to 0 to 1.
features.expected_model_benefit: Precombines X4 and X5 in a simple ratio, reducing the burden on the SVM to discover a common linear projection.

features.name: smooth_core_projection_01
features.description: Normalized weighted composite of X1-X2 hump, X3 curvature, X4 level, and X5 level.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines nonlinear and first-order row information into one calibrated axis, giving the linear SVM a high-information margin direction.

features.name: background_center_energy_01
features.description: Radial distance of X6 through X10 from the midpoint 0.5, normalized to 0 to 1.
features.expected_model_benefit: Lets a linear margin account for unusual background-coordinate magnitude without fitting five separate weak directions.

features.name: surface_alignment_judgment
features.description: Non-formulaic analyst rating from 0.0 to 1.0 of how strongly the row matches a coherent smooth-surface pattern: mid-range X1-X2 product, X3 far from the center, and elevated X4/X5.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a row-level qualitative score aligned with the smooth surface pattern, useful when formula features leave small local mismatches.

features.name: background_irregularity_judgment
features.description: Non-formulaic analyst rating from 0.0 to 1.0 of how unusual the X6-X10 combination appears relative to the training-fold 0 to 1 support and near-uniform column summaries.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a compact qualitative covariate-pattern score that can adjust margins for atypical background combinations.
